content.text: In Kenya, digital creators face a significant challenge: accessing reliable payment processing for their digital products. With Stripe and PayPal often unavailable, many turn to cumbersome workarounds. However, there's a better solution: sovereign commerce [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]]. This approach enables you to own your payment and delivery pipeline, ensuring uninterrupted sales and maximum control. By deploying your own infrastructure, you can bypass platform restrictions and focus on what matters most - creating and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-presets-without-stripe-what-nobody-tells-you-3|Selling Presets]]-notion-templates-crypto-explained-digital-creators-stripe|selling]] digital products.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

The key to successful digital product sales lies in having a robust, platform-agnostic infrastructure. By utilizing GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, you can create a reliable and scalable sales pipeline. This infrastructure is designed to work seamlessly with crypto payments, allowing you to tap into a global market without relying on traditional payment processors.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your sovereign commerce infrastructure, you'll need to gather a few essential components. This includes a domain name, a GitHub or Cloudflare account, and a basic understanding of crypto payments. You'll also need to choose a suitable crypto payment processor, such as NOWPayments, which offers support for over 300 cryptocurrencies and a competitive 0.5% fee. With these elements in place, you can begin building your infrastructure.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline involves integrating your chosen crypto payment processor with your backend logic and order storage. This can be achieved using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate the payment verification and product delivery process. By leveraging the power of crypto payments, you can ensure fast and secure transactions, while also providing a seamless experience for your customers.
Own your payment pipeline with sovereign commerce infrastructure.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Scaling a sovereign digital store requires no infrastructure changes at any realistic volume level for most individual creators. Cloudflare Workers processes each webhook event independently — ten simultaneous orders are handled as ten separate processes with no queue congestion. Supabase handles hundreds of concurrent database operations on the free tier. Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month on the free tier — enough for significant daily sales volume. Cloudflare Pages serves the storefront to any number of concurrent visitors without capacity constraints. NOWPayments processes payment volume without per-transaction approval delays.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Sell digital products without platform restrictions.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The Complete Builder Kit offers a comprehensive solution for digital creators looking to establish a sovereign commerce infrastructure. By investing in this kit, you can gain the knowledge, tools, and confidence needed to succeed in the digital marketplace, without relying on restrictive platforms like Stripe or PayPal.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your sovereign commerce infrastructure, follow these steps: choose a hosting platform, set up your backend logic and order storage, integrate a crypto payment processor, configure your payment and delivery pipeline, test your infrastructure, and launch your digital product sales. By methodically completing these steps, you can ensure a smooth and successful deployment, and start selling digital products with confidence.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is sovereign commerce infrastructure?
Sovereign commerce infrastructure refers to a platform-agnostic sales pipeline that you own and control, enabling you to sell digital products without relying on restrictive platforms.
How do I choose a crypto payment processor?
When selecting a crypto payment processor, consider factors such as fees, supported cryptocurrencies, and ease of integration with your infrastructure.
Can I use my existing domain name?
Yes, you can use your existing domain name with your sovereign commerce infrastructure, providing a seamless experience for your customers.
How do I handle customer support?
To handle customer support, establish a clear communication channel and have a plan in place for addressing potential issues and resolving disputes.
Is the Complete Builder Kit suitable for beginners?

Yes, the Complete Builder Kit is designed to be accessible to creators of all skill levels, providing comprehensive documentation and support to help you deploy your sovereign commerce infrastructure.
